definitions.data: Precheck-A raw rows: /mnt/dev/AG3S_VLA-storage/results/development/20261022T001543+0900_8e200ada6d53_f62e49bedd53/verify/IFG-PRECHECK-A/raw_v2/IFG-APPLE-SPLIT_ep<E>.json. Original record: run 20261019T132719+0900_f15e587290f6_11408fd6d27f, kit verify/IFG-APPLE-SPLIT, arm SPL: server chunks (server_chunk_alignment.block, chunk_{offset+k}.npz: ESDF grids, summary_json) and client frames runs/SPL/SPL_ep<E>_s<S>/ag3s/run_0000/step_<k>.npz (qpos, depth_<cam> uint16 mm, K_<cam>, T_base_cam_<cam> for zed_left, wrist_cam_l, wrist_cam_r). step k <-> planning row k <-> request k (t_step and qpos checked equal).
definitions.unknown_row: A precheck row with traj 'ref', binding True (h < 0 on the policy chunk), in a pre-grasp request (summary grasp.state latched or closing) and R1 source 'unknown'. Fail scenes 211, 320, 526, 954, 979, 1313 (U1-U3); control scenes 250, 126, 572 (U4). Row = (request k, plan step, sphere q).
definitions.field: Rebuilt from the chunk npz by AG3S.trajopt.experiments.fixed_input_ablation.build_field(z, outside_distance=1.0). Layer L of a row = target-free (CuroboEsdfField.target_free_distance / target_free_gradient) when the row's recorded layer is 'target_free', else the main composed layer (distance / gradient). Fidelity: |d_L(p) - precheck d_mm| <= 0.05 mm, p = the row's recorded sphere centre.
definitions.surface_point: s = p - d_L(p) * g / |g|, g = gradient of L at p (the precheck R2 point). The surface voxel of a row = the voxel of the grid of the answering tier at p (recorded tier: 'target_free' -> esdf_free grid, 'fine' -> esdf grid, 'coarse' -> esdf_coarse grid) that contains s (nearest grid index). Reported with it: d_L(s).
definitions.observations: The depth pixels the TSDF integrated up to request k: frames f = 0..k (checked: summary esdf_stats.frames == k + 1), all three depth cameras, depth = recorded uint16 / 1000 m, pixels with 0.05 <= depth <= 3.0 m, back-projected with the recorded K and T_base_cam (AG3S backproject convention: X = (u - cx) z / fx). Robot pixels removed by the reconstructed server self-filter mask: AG3S.ag3s.stages.robot_filter.depth_robot_mask on the full-resolution backproject (PointCloudConfig(range_max=2.0) = server --range-max default), robot model = grounding_report.build_robot_model(TransportScene of model_transport.xml) (= serve_safe.build_ag3s filter_robot), fingers by set_finger_joints_from_scene, q = scene.robot_state() at step f qpos, guard centre / radius = manipulated.centroid / radius + 5 mm of the summary of request f-1. Mask fidelity: reconstructed mask pixel count vs recorded esdf_stats.per_camera[cam].n_masked_px for every (frame, camera); reported as count of exact matches and max |diff|. Masked pixels are not supporting observations (they were integrated as unobserved); their count within r_sup is reported separately.
definitions.support: Supporting observations O(s) of a row = unmasked observation points of frames 0..k within r_sup of s. r_sup = 10 mm when the answering tier is fine or target_free, 20 mm when coarse (the precheck R1 tolerances). Also reported: distance from s to the nearest unmasked observation point of frames 0..k (any distance up to 100 mm) and that point's label.
definitions.point_label: Label of an observation point o of frame f: geom seen at its pixel in a MuJoCo segmentation render of model_transport_pick_place_obstacles.xml (client scene; obstacle placed by PickPlaceObstacleManager.activate(profile) from the episode's --obstacle-config/--obstacle-profile), d.qpos = step f qpos, camera pose overwritten by the recorded T_base_cam (OpenCV -> MuJoCo axes diag(1,-1,-1)), 640x480. Accepted when |recorded depth - rendered depth| <= 5 mm at that pixel; otherwise label = argmin over GT classes of the signed GT distance at frame f state if <= 5 mm (ifg_audit_ats.Scene geometry + analytic post + all collidable robot geoms), else 'unlabelled'. Geom -> label: body apple -> target; banana / orange / pear -> neighbour; crate -> crate; pick_obstacle_* -> post; table -> table; robot subtree (body 'base') -> robot_hand (geom in replay geom_sets 'hand') / robot_inactive_hand ('inactive_hand') / robot_body (other); other geoms -> room; no geom -> none.
definitions.moved_test: v1 (pre-registered, 02:50 KST): For a point labelled target, neighbour or crate observed at frame f < k: 'current' when the GT signed distance from o to that class at the request-k state is <= 5 mm, else 'moved'. Points of frame k are current. post / table / room are static.
definitions.point_source: robot_hand / robot_inactive_hand / robot_body -> robot_self; target current -> target_at_request_gt; neighbour current -> neighbour_fruit; crate current, post, table -> support_surface (table / crate / post); target / neighbour / crate moved -> memory_stale (shape observed earlier at a place the object no longer occupies at request k); room, none, unlabelled -> other.
definitions.row_source: Shares of the supporting points over the point sources. Matched sources = those with share >= 0.25. No supporting point -> field_artefact (no observation point within r_sup). Exactly one matched source -> that source. Two or more -> ambiguous (counted separately, with the combination). Sub-labels kept in the numbers: robot_self by hand / inactive hand / body and by frame (f == k vs earlier); support_surface by table / crate / post.
definitions.task_category_map: Task U1 classes -> these names: robot self body -> robot_self; held / dropped / pushed target apple at that request's GT position -> target_at_request_gt; neighbour fruit outside its GT -> neighbour_fruit; table / crate / post surface standing out from GT -> support_surface; memory shape (kept / stale) -> memory_stale; field artefact (no observation point) -> field_artefact; other -> other; several -> ambiguous.
definitions.voxel_counting: Voxel = unique (scene, request k, answering grid, voxel index of s). Its source = the source of the most-violated row (smallest h) among the rows sharing it. Row counts and voxel counts both reported.
definitions.u2_distance: Distance from s to the GT surface of the row's source at the request-k state, unsigned |D|: robot_self -> all collidable robot geoms (visual-only robot meshes not included); target_at_request_gt -> apple (collision + visual); neighbour_fruit -> the neighbour fruit classes; support_surface -> table, crate, post; memory_stale -> the class(es) of its moved points; field_artefact / other / ambiguous -> nearest over all GT classes including robot. Median and p95 in mm.
definitions.u2_visibility: s is 'visible at k' when, for at least one depth camera of frame k (recorded K, T_base_cam), s projects inside the 640x480 image with camera z >= 0.05 m and the recorded depth at that pixel is >= z_s - 10 mm (line of sight not blocked; robot pixels count as blocking). 'Observed at k' additionally needs |recorded depth - z_s| <= 10 mm. Fractions over rows.
definitions.u3: The 22 pre-grasp requests of the 6 fail scenes whose most-violated active_ref row has R1 source unknown (precheck A3 by_dominant_source_ref.unknown, recomputed with ifg_precheck_a.per_request). Per request: scene, k, state, active_ref rows, unknown rows, U1 source counts of its unknown rows, U1 source of its most-violated row, correction_mm, HOLD, penetration_to_mm, out-window worst R1 group (all from precheck raw except the U1 columns).
definitions.u4: Same U1 rules on the unknown rows of the control scenes 250, 126, 572.
definitions.phases: Per scene and per phase (latched / closing) as in precheck.
definitions.moved_test_revision: v2, written 2026-10-22 02:55 KST after the v1 collection, before the v2 collection. Reason (a fact found in the v1 output, not a result preference): the v1 test compares a crate pixel's point with the crate COLLISION boxes, but the camera sees the crate VISUAL geoms, which include rims (crate_vis_rim_*, top at +0.067 m vs collision wall top +0.060 m, 2 mm wider) and slats; the crate free-joint pose was unchanged over the measured frames (ep526 k0-31, ep1313 k0-73: |dpos| <= 0.1 mm), so v1 labelled unmoved crate-rim points 'moved'. v2 rule: a point labelled target / neighbour / crate observed at frame f < k is carried with the body it was seen on (MuJoCo body of the rendered geom; for geometric-fallback labels the class body) from its frame-f pose to its request-k pose (o_k = R_k R_f^T (o - x_f) + x_k, body poses from mj_forward of the step qpos); 'moved' when |o_k - o| > 5 mm. Everything else unchanged. v1 numbers are kept under numbers.v1_moved_test_gt_distance; v1 raw = verify/IFG-UNKNOWN/raw, v1 figures = verify/IFG-UNKNOWN/v1_figures (not delivered); v2 raw = verify/IFG-UNKNOWN/raw_v2.

notes: Moved test was revised once (definitions.moved_test_revision, 02:55 KST) after the v1 collection; v1 counts kept in numbers.v1_moved_test_gt_distance. v1 -> v2 changes: fail6 memory_stale 1270 -> 1144, support_surface 1 -> 132, target_at_request_gt 87 -> 73, ambiguous 5 -> 14; control3 target 22 -> 12, memory_stale 0 -> 9, ambiguous 0 -> 1.
ep979 has 0 unknown pre-grasp rows (nothing to classify). Fail-6 unknown rows: 2,573 (precheck 2,573); control-3: 22.

Self-filter mask mismatch: ep211 frames 23 and 24 (head, left_wrist), reconstructed vs recorded n_masked_px 53479/53823, 9912/12776, 53458/53803, 9847/12652; rows of ep211 requests >= 23 use frames 23-24 reconstructed with that difference.

U2 robot distance uses collidable robot geoms only (visual-only robot meshes not included). Geometric-fallback labels (309 of 161,872 labelled points) cannot split robot into hand / inactive hand / body (mapped to robot_body); 54 points unlabelled (render-vs-recorded depth > 5 mm and no GT class within 5 mm).

U3 'worst link' and precheck link names are URDF/TO names; the MJCF/URDF left-finger name swap (ee_finger_l1 <-> l2) applies when matching them to MuJoCo bodies. Point labels (robot_hand / robot_inactive_hand) come from MJCF bodies EE_BODY_*/ee_finger_* of the replay geom_sets.
Answering tiers of the unknown rows: fail 6 target_free 2,062, fine 511; control 3 target_free 22. No coarse-tier row, so r_sup 20 mm was not used.

v1 figures (not delivered) are in /mnt/dev/AG3S_VLA-storage/results/development/20261022T023709+0900_055f2ea2f00b_418a15757d23/verify/IFG-UNKNOWN/v1_figures; delivered figures are the v2 ones under AG3S/ag3s/docs/figures/ifg-unknown/.
